answer: Every gate that believes the applicant fails identically, so this gate believes the archive. Master plumber licence with trade licensing board attestation builds the archive from four-year apprenticeship, 8,000 site hours, journeyman exam, licence bond and annual. The horizon is reuse: the evidence already exists, created for work, tax, or licensing years ago. Rebuilding it from nothing means recreating every piece, and the anchor in each piece is a clerk or registrar holding an independent copy. The forge is the comparison — the copies agree, or the applicant walks away.
